34:class QtileState:
35:    """Represents the state of the Qtile object
36:
37:    This is used for restoring state across restarts or config reloads.
38:
39:    If `restart` is True, the current set of groups will be saved in the state. This is
40:    useful when restarting for Qtile version updates rather than reloading the config.
41:    ScratchPad groups are saved for both reloading and restarting.
42:    """

44:    def __init__(self, qtile: Qtile, restart: bool = True) -> None:
45:        self.groups = []
46:        self.screens = {}
47:        self.current_screen = 0
48:        self.scratchpads = {}
49:        self.orphans: list[int] = []
50:        self.restart = restart  # True when restarting, False when config reloading
51:
52:        for group in qtile.groups:
53:            if isinstance(group, ScratchPad):
54:                self.scratchpads[group.name] = group.get_state()
55:            elif restart:
56:                self.groups.append((group.name, group.layout.name, group.label))
57:
58:        for index, screen in enumerate(qtile.screens):
59:            self.screens[index] = screen.group.name
60:            if screen == qtile.current_screen:
61:                self.current_screen = index

63:    def apply(self, qtile: Qtile) -> None:
64:        """
65:        Rearrange the windows in the specified Qtile object according to this
66:        QtileState.
67:        """
68:        for group, layout, label in self.groups:
69:            try:
70:                qtile.groups_map[group].layout = layout
71:                qtile.groups_map[group].label = label
72:            except KeyError:
